findings.title: Document Storage Exposure
findings.rootCause: documents bucket was public with bucket-wide SELECT policies and getPublicUrl consumers.
findings.changeMade: Bucket set private; wide SELECT/INSERT policies dropped; scoped uid/company policies; app uses short-lived signed URLs.
